text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(――The timing to make my move is...
now!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!!

Daiichi Ruby accelerated at the turning point.
Her flash-like speed
captivated my gaze completely...—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Now, let's see everyone's reaction...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh...
Now that running style truly befits the "Illustrious Clan"!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Daiichi Ruby really is
the indisputable favorite for this year's Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Pedigree, poise, ability—she's flawless in every way!
She's younger than me, but... wow, I'm truly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I have accomplished what I needed to in this race.
If so, then as planned...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...The time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Could you please provide a critique regarding today's race?

While holding a post-race review with Daiichi Ruby,
I reflect on her run todayâespecially
her "speed."
A brilliant, lightning-fast speed... You could truly call it a gift from the heavens.
Even among the speedsters in the sprint division, she can more than hold her own... That was how much potential I felt in her.
choice_data_list: (If she were to run on the stage of supreme speed—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Will that be all?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Now then, based on these points of reflection,
please adjust the training menu accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Time is limited before the Oka Sho. Let us proceed efficiently.
choice_data_list: (So it's finally time for the Oka Sho...)

text_block_list.text:
As a race her mother once won,
high expectations weigh upon her shoulders as well—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, but I don't think there's any need for you to be nervous, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you have any concerns regarding me,
please speak up so we may improve.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If that is not the case,
then please carry yourself with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall demonstrate through my demeanor that there is not the slightest cause for concern regarding the "Splendid Clan."

And so... our next target race was finally the first jewel of the Triple Tiara.
We will take on the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, stand proud and tall.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Because finally... I can truly become part of the 'Illustrious Family.'"
